scope: Bounded read-only investigation. No trace replay, signing, model calls, code edits, appeals, deploys or Git actions.
node_source_limit: Public unauthenticated GitHub API for genlayerlabs/genlayer-node returned 404. Actual live node binary version and internal state-selection implementation were not verified. Consensus release v0.5 does not by itself identify a node binary version.

node_documentation.title: docs: sync documentation from genlayer-node v0.5.13

findings.claim: Node v0.5.13 official docs already document status accepted/finalized and blockNumber for gen_call and gen_getContractState. transaction_hash_variant is absent from those archived method docs. Equal results across supplied selectors cannot establish whether a selector is honored or ignored.

Verified Main.submitAppeal sets the appealed transaction status and emits TransactionActivated for leader-timeout/undetermined appeals; the inspected path does not enqueue descendants for recomputation. RoundsCreation.createNewLeaderTimeoutAppealRound changes the round by +2 and rotates leader. RevealingPhase explicitly leaves the original final-decision queue position intact and accepts the new outcome when alreadyInFinalQueue.

The explicit descendant recomputation branch is guarded by newRoundData.round > 0 during post-majority processing; it calls addTransactionToPendingQueue and returns descendant ids, and Main then emits TransactionNeedsRecomputation. This is distinct from merely executing round 2 after a direct leader appeal.

An accepted descendant snapshot overshadowing the earlier-slot replay is consistent with the observation, but not proved by public source or obtained trie data. Do not identify this hypothesis as the confirmed root cause.

FinalizationPhase changes native status, queues and message-processing flags; the inspected finalize path does not itself request descendant recomputation. It is therefore unsupported to promise that FINAL will repair application state automatically.

trie_attempts.doc_contract: Read node internal DB trie for txID/round; no replay documented for this method.
trie_attempts.result: No trie, keys or root digest returned. Request/metadata/doc bytes saved. HTTP error response body was not retained by the urllib exception handler; no raw RPC result exists. No retry or alternate access used.

safe_remaining_read_plan: After both native transactions are actually FINALIZED, save stored/receipt statuses, canonical finalization event blocks, and fresh item14/item23 getters; do not equate Accepted receipt with applied application state.

Use documented gen_call type read with status and explicit blockNumber, and gen_getContractState with the same block/status, comparing a fixed snapshot before descendant acceptance, after ancestor replay acceptance, and after finalization. Record syncedBlock and returned raw bytes; compare SHA256 of raw contract state. This can establish observed state changes, not node internal parent-trie selection by itself.
If a node operator exposes documented gen_dbg_trie, compare saved trie snapshots for a264 round2 and cedffa round0. Public RPC denied both requests here. No arbitrary selector or RPC invented.
Do not invoke gen_dbg_traceTransaction blindly: v0.5.13 docs explicitly say missing/pruned traces cause automatic replay. This could execute nondeterministic work outside the no-new-calls scope.

repair_after_final_and_deadline.conclusion: No supported permissionless repair was established for an already-finalized positive receipt whose application slot remains pending. Do not resend or appeal on this evidence.
reasons: Verified Appeals accepts Accepted/Revealing/LT/UND/VT, not Finalized; submitting an appeal of FINAL is invalid.
Application probe enforces the frozen trial deadline (contracts/impeach.py:923-924), so a newly submitted application call after closure is not a valid repair.
Recomputation queue mutation is restricted to consensus modules, not a public user RPC; the reviewed docs expose no force-recompute RPC.
Historical trie inspection or trace debug does not itself certify a state repair or consensus application.
